title: Installation medium to persistent installed system, on physical hardware
notRunReason: No physical machine is available to this project. Every result it holds is QEMU with software rendering.

preconditions.requirement: The device record is complete and recorded BEFORE first boot.
preconditions.because: A machine described after a failure is described by somebody with a theory.

preconditions.requirement: The ISO digest is verified on the writing host AND re-read from the written medium, both matching 823d50ca.
preconditions.because: A stick written from a corrupted download produces a hardware report about something that is not the candidate. Verifying only on the host does not detect a bad write.

preconditions.requirement: Secure Boot state, TPM presence and firmware version are recorded as found, not as configured for convenience.
preconditions.because: Disabling Secure Boot to make an install succeed produces a result about a different configuration.

steps.expect: firmware hands off to the medium's bootloader; the Bunny Setup surface is reached
steps.failIf: a shim/GRUB fallback path runs, or the medium is not offered by firmware

steps.expect: real storage devices are enumerated with correct sizes and controller types
steps.failIf: NVMe or SATA devices are missing, or sizes are wrong

steps.expect: LUKS2 volume created; installation completes with findings: []
steps.failIf: any finding is recorded, or the install completes unencrypted when encryption was chosen

steps.step: first boot from disk, passphrase unlock
steps.expect: the LUKS passphrase prompt appears on the real console and unlock succeeds
steps.failIf: unlock takes longer than the VM baseline by more than a factor of two without explanation (see KNOWN_LIMITATIONS L-LUKS)

steps.expect: greeter renders on the panel's native resolution; typed password authenticates
steps.failIf: the greeter renders at a fallback resolution, or the session fails to start

steps.step: Bunny desktop reaches a usable state
steps.expect: the shell extension loads; the desktop is laid out for the panel's actual resolution
steps.failIf: the layout solver produces overlapping or offscreen elements on a resolution other than 1920x1080 or 1366x768, the only two ever tested

steps.expect: the Companion autostarts and responds to interaction
steps.failIf: the Companion is absent, or the selected renderer mode is silently degraded without a recorded reason
shutdown hangs, or any earlier step regresses

steps.expect: companion mode, scale and position, voice configuration, permissions, locale, hostname and user data all survive
steps.failIf: any recorded setting differs, including a difference that looks like an improvement

gradingRules: A successful live boot alone is NOT an installation result. H1.1 passing while H1.3 is NOT_RUN grades the journey NOT_RUN.
Every step must resolve. A step with no evidence is NOT_RUN, never PASS.
One machine produces one row. No result here generalises to a class of hardware.
A photograph is required wherever the expectation is about what a person sees. A journal line saying a surface started is not evidence that it rendered.

whatAPassWouldAndWouldNotEstablish.would: That this exact artifact installs and persists on one identified machine.
whatAPassWouldAndWouldNotEstablish.wouldNot: That it installs on any other machine, that performance figures transfer, or that any measurement taken under llvmpipe applies to this machine's GPU.
